scope: 151 original 198-edge artwork research keys; 2 distinct unapproved external alternative paintings (Ribera and Wenceslas burial), 3 separate March leads; 10 verified first-party/institutional colour JPEG research files; 170 original gap-date records. This is NOT the app runtime Gallery.
releaseRules: A verified source JPEG is not a permission to add the artwork to any new date: owner placement approval is separate.
Keep 103 historically globally rejected original IDs out of releases; do not silently revive via alias/Commons/mirror/crop.

Protect 27 Prayer NONE slots and all existing live image assignments; this registry is not app runtime input.
Photographs must be image-specific open licensed, correctly credited, colour-appropriate, checksummed and checked at app 320/390px container before any release.
Do not auto-promote Wikimedia Commons files unless handpicked by owner, even if source says Public Domain.
Do not conflate artwork public-domain status with the selected photographic file's rights.
Do not use Prado photographs, pay licences, contact collection owners or deploy via Vercel.
Image artifacts from GitHub Actions expire; source SHA plus provenance does not mean a durable licensed production file exists.
The three supplementary March leads do not change the 362/365 official Calendar research census until reconciled and approved.
Priority ranking is operational work order, not artistic endorsement or approval; contextual and partial Gospel episodes remain held.
A successfully acquired painting photograph may still fail Gospel-subject readability on mobile; keep Rijks SK-A-868 out of hero publication despite source licence and high pixel count.
Nationalmuseum NM420/NM1134 return HTTP 403 on their exact official JPG endpoints: never count as acquired, and no non-owner-handpicked Commons source enters curated pool.

Official museum image policies reviewed 10 Nov 2026: Louvre, Cincinnati, Timken and KHM institutional photographs have no confirmed commercial-use permission without prior licence; their 9 exact work keys are held, while a separate genuinely open photograph may still be researched.

27 priority-oil ICCD official catalogue photographs do not inherit CC BY 4.0 open-data rights. ICCD requires institution-specific image reproduction authorization, potentially a charge. No free commercial app image claimed without a distinct open-photo source; work identities remain usable research leads.

Nationalmuseum's own high-resolution media.nationalmuseum.se is the first-party alternative for NM420 and NM1134, but its exact media records and byte-specific licences remain unverified. An inventory search is not source-photo QA.
MSK Ghent S-43 downloaded and independently SHA-verified. Public Domain Mark in IIIF is not automatic monetised app approval; rights and visible diagonal image-line quality hold both remain.

Nationalmuseum and Krakow: first-party portal search and HTML/image-link inspection are investigations, never a licence clearance or actual original-photo acquisition; require exact accession, artwork/scene, open licence, downloaded bytes and SHA before publication review.

Both Nationalmuseum and MNK public art portals are JavaScript-rendered and expose no exact photo links to static HTTP. Do not mistake a successfully completed source probe for source-photo acquisition or an absent HTML image for an absent museum photograph.

The final eight first-party image candidates were source-triaged: four official-photo restricted, two object-only no file, two photograph rights/identity unresolved. Zero directly publishable new colour originals were acquired. Do not call these eight publicly licensed image sources.

Met 437005 Wenceslas burial is separate from Škréta's Eucharistic-host scene. It is exact saint but different narrative and non-Baroque; source photo is CC0 but not historically user-approved. Owner rejection check and mobile editorial certification still required.

Batch4 fuzzy 35 museum artwork hits yielded only 2 saint-specific thematic works (Wenceslas burial, Athanasius retable); 33 are unrelated. AIC Athanasius retable is not a verified JPEG in this register and not an oil painting.
